_doc: Bosch Rexroth strut profile 40x80L: 80 x 40 mm with the 10 mm slot, anodised. Dimensions and section figures are from the MGE 14.0 catalogue, which prints them to 0.1 cm² and 0.1 cm⁴: on a section this small that is a step of several percent. It is described lying flat, so inertia_x is the smaller second moment (the catalogue's Iy). The drawn outline leaves out the true shape of the corner hollows (drawn as squares of about the same area), the bores' square form with their notches (drawn round) and the steps that thin each lip toward the opening, so it comes out heavier than the catalogue's figures.
